stem: Tendai uses a laptop to write programs for his school's computer club in Harare.

parts.label: (a)
parts.stem: Describe the difference between system software and application software. Give an example of each.

points.description: System software provides the services the computer needs, e.g. operating system / utility
Application software provides the services the user needs, e.g. word processor / spreadsheet / browser

answerSpec.markingNotes: Example answer: System software, such as the operating system, provides the services the computer needs; application software, such as a spreadsheet, provides the services the user needs.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Describe **three** functions of an operating system.

points.description: A named function with a description (e.g. managing memory: allocates RAM to processes)
A second (e.g. managing peripherals and drivers / managing files)
A third (e.g. multitasking / handling interrupts / security / user accounts / interface / platform for applications)

answerSpec.markingNotes: Example answer: It manages memory by allocating RAM to each process; it manages peripherals through their drivers; and it provides security through user accounts and passwords.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: Classify each event as a hardware interrupt or a software interrupt.

left.content: His program divides a number by zero
The printer runs out of paper
Two processes try to access the same memory location

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem: Describe how the processor handles an interrupt.

points.description: At the end of the current FDE cycle the processor checks for interrupts / compares priority
The current state (register contents) is saved and the interrupt service routine for the source is run
The saved state is restored and the interrupted task continues

answerSpec.markingNotes: Example answer: After the current fetch-decode-execute cycle the processor checks for an interrupt with a higher priority. It saves its register contents, runs the matching interrupt service routine, then restores the registers and continues the task.

parts.label: (e)
parts.stem: Tendai's translator stops at the first line containing an error. Which translator is it?

options.rationale: Reports all errors after translating the whole program.

parts.explanation: Interpreters translate and run line by line.

parts.label: (f)
parts.stem: Which IDE function formats his code with consistent indentation and colour?

options.rationale: Suggests the rest of a word.

parts.label: (g)
parts.stem: True or false: a compiler produces an executable file that can run without the compiler.

explanation: (c) hardware, software, hardware, software; (e) interpreter; (f) prettyprint; (g) true.
hints: Compiler: whole program, executable. Interpreter: line by line, stops at first error.

stem: A large citrus estate near Mazowe uses an automated irrigation system, fruit-picking robots and an expert system.

parts.label: (a)
parts.stem: Describe how sensors, a microprocessor and actuators work together to water the orchards.

points.description: Moisture sensors take readings continuously; an ADC converts them to digital
The microprocessor compares each reading with a stored (minimum) value
If below the value, a signal is sent to an actuator (pump / valve) to start watering; stopped when the stored value is reached

answerSpec.markingNotes: Example answer: Moisture sensors take readings, which an ADC converts to digital. The microprocessor compares each with the stored minimum; if it is lower, it signals the actuator to open the valve, and closes it when the soil is moist enough. This repeats continuously.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Which component is an actuator in the irrigation system?

options.content: The motor that opens the valve

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: Give **one** advantage and **one** disadvantage of the automated irrigation system for the estate.

points.description: Advantage: waters only when needed, saving water / works day and night / responds faster than workers
Disadvantage: expensive to install and maintain / faulty sensor could over- or under-water

answerSpec.markingNotes: Example answer: It waters only when needed, saving water, but a faulty sensor could leave trees dry.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem: Describe the characteristics of the fruit-picking robot that make it a robot.

points.description: Mechanical structure / framework (e.g. arm, gripper, wheels)
Electrical components: sensors (e.g. camera), microprocessor and actuators (motors)
Programmable (can be programmed / reprogrammed for different tasks)

answerSpec.markingNotes: Example answer: It has a mechanical structure (an arm with a gripper on wheels), electrical components (a camera to find fruit, a microprocessor and motors) and it is programmable.

parts.label: (e)
parts.stem: The estate's expert system diagnoses citrus diseases. Match each component to its role.

right.content: Applies the rules to the answers to reach a conclusion
Asks questions and displays the diagnosis and explanation

parts.label: (f)
parts.stem: The estate's yield-prediction program becomes more accurate each season as it adapts its own data. What is this?
parts.explanation: Machine learning adapts its own processes or data.

explanation: (b) the valve motor; (e) knowledge base facts, rule base rules, inference engine reasons, interface communicates; (f) machine learning.
hints: Sensor → ADC → microprocessor compares with stored value → actuator → repeat.
